title.name: RO_WEB Runtime Handler Registry
title.purpose: Shared handler taxonomy for all player skills. Formula data lives in Runtime Profiles; handlers are reusable.

physical_damage.description: Weapon/physical damage, hit count, knockback and status chance.

passive.description: Recalculated passive stats and conditional bonuses.

timed_status.description: Buff/debuff/status with duration and level values.

ground_area.description: Ground-targeted persistent or instant area effect.

toggle.description: Toggle state with activation and cancellation.

mount.description: RO_WEB mount state and future atlas swap hook.

special_review.description: Skill requires custom flow or unsupported systems.
